summary: Finstad frames Gaza conflict as Iranian-backed terrorism, declares pride in standing with Israel, and pledges continued support for Iron Dome funding.
quote: I'm proud to stand with Israel and will continue to support funding for the lifesaving Iron Dome defense system.

summary: On day of Hamas attack, Finstad states he will 'always stand united' with Israel and supports its right to defend itself against 'heinous acts of terror.'

summary: Gaza Watch records that Finstad voted to provide support to Israel after the October 2023 Hamas attack; site rates his stance 100/100 Israel-leaning.

summary: JCRC confirms Rep. Brad Finstad (MN) voted in favor of the $95B aid package including $17B military assistance to Israel and $9B humanitarian relief for Gaza.
